subject: 4EB1
skill: Create an effective original description of a specified place, with controlled selection and organisation.

customQuiz.rationale: Source-demand contract at the original maximum. No original10/15/30-mark demand is scaled into a custom2/4/6-mark quiz; a separate reviewed adaptation is needed.

requirements: Create an effective original description of a specified place, with controlled selection and organisation.
Create independent age-appropriate original source material/prompt; do not reproduce or paraphrase the publisher’s source sentence by sentence.
Keep all question instructions and assessment-objective demands consistent with the frozen stimulus.
evidenceContract: Freeze original passage/prompt, evidence spans or objective grids, and the complete private marking package before any answer.
Preserve separate objective maxima; release feedback only after the session is complete.

domain.semanticRule: Create an effective original description of a specified place, with controlled selection and organisation.

constraints: Original stimulus quality, reading demand and difficulty remain unvalidated; this is not a runtime generator.
Do not serve or activate this source-demand contract before generative and response calibration.
Keep printed-choice maxima separate from compulsory candidate totals.
Do not impose an automatic400-word penalty or mechanically count rhetorical devices.
relationships: Generated instructions and private evidence must refer to the same frozen original text/prompt.
Separate reading, communication and accuracy objectives retain independent credit.
difficultyControls: Reading complexity, inference distance, viewpoint contrasts and writing form need source-demand review; numerical mark similarity does not prove equal difficulty.

transformations.conditions: Independent original text/prompt with the same reviewed demand; validation pending.
A different maximum requires a separate calibrated contract.

solutionProcedure: Interpret the audience, purpose and objective of the task.
Develop a coherent supported response fulfilling the task.
Review the complete response against each separate source grid.

acceptableAlternatives: The official indicative content is not exhaustive; defensible interpretations supported by the passage require review.
contradictionRules: Judge the full response and source evidence; do not award a keyword merely because it appears amid contradictory claims.

levelRubric.descriptor: No material meeting the assessed demand.
Limited clarity and limited attention to purpose, reader or form.
Broadly suitable communication with straightforward control of purpose and form.
Clear writing suited to reader and purpose, with appropriate form and register.
Effective communication with secure control of purpose, form and register.
Subtle, perceptive communication with sophisticated control of reader, purpose and form.
No material meeting the assessed demand.
Basic vocabulary and repetitive syntax; weak control of spelling and punctuation.
Ordered ideas with developing paragraphing and some accurate sentence control.
Developed ideas, meaningful paragraphs and varied accurate language.
Deliberate cohesive structure and selective vocabulary with occasional errors.
Precise, cohesive handling of complex ideas and varied structures; rare spelling slips do not obscure meaning.

commonErrors.description: Treating an unsupported assertion or a copied list as a developed, source-supported response.

testPlan: Validate original-generation boundaries and source-demand equivalence before serving.
Calibrate full, partial, unsupported, contradictory and alternative responses independently for each objective.
Do not infer learner calibration or a live implementation from source extraction.

runtime.seedPolicy: No runtime generator yet; any future seed must freeze all content and objective rubrics before answers.

blockers: Source-demand and official grids are recorded, but original-generation quality and response recognition are not calibrated.
No runtime implementation or validated custom-mark blueprint; AI remains last.
